title: Intel Reports High Demand and Sold-Out Budget Laptop Chips
excerpt: Intel executives state that demand for affordable Wildcat Lake chips exceeds supply, leading to sold-out inventory.
body_html:
During a recent earnings call, Intel announced that demand for its budget-focused Wildcat Lake processors is currently outpacing available supply. According to company executives, the cost-optimized chips have experienced significant growth and are now completely sold out.

Chief Executive Officer Lip-Bu Tan stated that the strong interest in the affordable processors has stretched current production capabilities. Meanwhile, Chief Financial Officer David Zinsner confirmed the sold-out status, noting that the timing of the product's success aligns well with the company's goals for cost-optimized hardware offerings.
